description: Unique identifier assigned to each course in the course catalog.
business_meaning: Connects course metadata to preview and enrollment activity so performance can be measured at course level.
related_kpi: Course Preview Rate; Enrollment Rate; Conversion Rate; Course Popularity
notes: Primary key in courses dataset; foreign key in preview_logs and enrollments; not nullable; expected format C followed by digits; updated when a course is added.

description: Display name of the course shown to learners.
business_meaning: Helps business teams identify which course titles attract interest and convert learners.
related_kpi: Course Popularity; Enrollment Rate; Conversion Rate
notes: Should be human readable and unique enough for reporting; nullable values should be corrected before stakeholder reporting; updated when course catalog changes.

description: Learning category or subject area assigned to the course.
business_meaning: Allows comparison of demand, previews, enrollments, and conversion by learning domain.
notes: Valid examples include Programming, Data Science, Web Development, Design, and Marketing; should be standardized to avoid duplicate category labels.

description: Name of the instructor associated with the course.
business_meaning: Supports analysis of instructor-level learner interest, quality perception, and enrollment outcomes.
notes: Should match the instructor master list if available; may change when course ownership changes; not used as a primary key.

description: Listed course price in platform currency.
business_meaning: Used to analyze whether price affects preview-to-enrollment conversion.
notes: Must be zero or positive; 0.00 indicates a free course; update frequency depends on pricing changes; should not contain currency symbols.

description: Average learner rating for the course.
business_meaning: Represents learner satisfaction and course quality perception that may influence conversion.
notes: Expected range is 0.0 to 5.0; should be renamed course_rating for clarity; may be null for new courses with no ratings.

description: Unique identifier for a learner or platform user.
business_meaning: Links learner search, preview, and enrollment behavior across the funnel.
related_kpi: Unique Searchers; Preview Rate; Enrollment Rate; Conversion Rate
notes: Foreign key to user master data if available; not personally identifiable by itself; not nullable for event-level tracking.

description: Text entered by a learner in the platform search bar.
business_meaning: Captures learner intent and demand signals before course discovery.
notes: Can contain free text; should be trimmed and normalized for keyword analysis; nullable or blank values should be excluded from demand analysis.

description: Timestamp when the learner submitted a search query.
business_meaning: Supports time-based demand analysis and funnel sequencing.
related_kpi: Total Searches; Search-to-Preview Rate; Daily Search Trend
notes: ISO 8601 timestamp expected; should be stored in a consistent timezone; used for daily refresh and trend reporting.

description: Flag indicating whether a learner clicked or opened a course preview.
business_meaning: Measures direct learner interest in a course after discovery.
related_kpi: Course Preview Rate; Conversion Rate; Course Popularity
notes: Valid values are True and False; True counts as a preview click; should not be confused with page impressions.

description: Timestamp when the preview event was recorded.
business_meaning: Supports sequencing between search, preview, and enrollment events.
related_kpi: Course Preview Rate; Conversion Funnel Drop-off
notes: ISO 8601 timestamp expected; should occur after or near related search_time when linked by user_id; used for daily funnel reporting.

description: Unique identifier assigned to each enrollment record.
business_meaning: Represents a learner enrollment attempt or enrollment record for a course.
related_kpi: Enrollment Rate; Conversion Rate; Active Enrollments
notes: Primary key in enrollments dataset; not nullable; expected format E followed by digits; generated when an enrollment event is created.

description: Current status of the enrollment record.
business_meaning: Distinguishes successful active enrollments from pending or cancelled outcomes.
related_kpi: Enrollment Rate; Conversion Rate; Active Enrollment Rate
notes: Valid values include active, pending, cancelled, and completed if supported; active generally counts as successful conversion; update when enrollment state changes.

description: Timestamp when the enrollment record was created or last confirmed by the platform.
business_meaning: Used to analyze when learners convert after search or preview activity.
related_kpi: Enrollment Rate; Conversion Rate; Daily Enrollments
notes: ISO 8601 timestamp expected; should not precede the related preview_time for same learner-course conversion analysis; source file currently stored as enrollments.json in this repo.
